name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments for eligible farmer families.
eligibilitySummary: Landholding farmer families that satisfy the scheme's conditions and exclusions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection assistance for eligible women and households, subject to scheme terms.
eligibilitySummary: A woman aged at least 18 from an eligible poor household, with no existing household LPG connection.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
benefits: Housing assistance through applicable scheme components for eligible urban households.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible urban households in the EWS, LIG or MIG income groups, subject to housing ownership and previous-benefit conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
benefits: Loans through participating lenders for eligible non-corporate, non-farm micro and small business activities.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible small business owners and entrepreneurs, subject to lender assessment, loan purpose and applicable scheme conditions.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
benefits: Cashless hospitalisation cover for eligible beneficiaries at participating hospitals, subject to scheme rules.
eligibilitySummary: Eligibility depends on the applicable beneficiary identification rules, official records and any relevant state-specific expansion.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh, subject to the policy terms and applicable conditions.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible individual holders of participating bank or post-office accounts aged 18 to 50 at entry, with the required enrolment consent.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
benefits: Financial assistance for eligible college and university students under the applicable scholarship guidelines.
eligibilitySummary: Students meeting the relevant Class XII merit, course, income and other scheme conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
benefits: Maternity benefit for eligible pregnant and lactating women, subject to scheme conditions.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible women meeting the applicable pregnancy, childbirth, and beneficiary-category requirements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefits: Crop insurance against covered agricultural risks for eligible farmers under notified scheme conditions.
eligibilitySummary: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and meeting the applicable enrolment requirements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
benefits: Financial assistance for eligible rural households to construct a house, subject to scheme guidelines.
eligibilitySummary: Rural households identified through the applicable selection and verification process.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
benefits: Credit-linked subsidy support for eligible new micro-enterprise projects.
eligibilitySummary: Applicants and projects meeting the current scheme's age, project, activity and other conditions.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefits: A contributory pension scheme offering eligible subscribers a pension based on their selected contribution and applicable scheme terms.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 who meet the scheme's account, tax-status and other enrolment requirements.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme
benefits: Government-backed savings account for a girl child, with interest at the rate notified by the government.
eligibilitySummary: An account may be opened by a guardian in the name of a girl child before she turns 10, subject to account and family rules.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
benefits: Working-capital loan support for eligible street vendors under applicable scheme terms.
eligibilitySummary: Street vendors meeting the current scheme's identification, vending and application requirements.

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefits: Eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople may receive recognition, skill training, toolkit incentives, credit support and other scheme benefits.
eligibilitySummary: Traditional artisans working with eligible family-based trades, subject to age, trade, household and other scheme conditions.

name: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances
benefits: Eligible persons with disabilities may receive approved assistive devices, subject to the scheme's requirements and assistance limits.
eligibilitySummary: Applicants meeting disability certification, income, device and other applicable requirements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
benefits: Free food grains for eligible beneficiaries covered under the applicable National Food Security Act provisions.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible ration-card households and beneficiaries identified under applicable food-security rules.

name: PM CARES for Children Scheme
benefits: Support for eligible children who lost both parents, surviving parent, or legal guardian due to COVID-19, subject to the scheme's specific conditions.
eligibilitySummary: Children meeting the scheme's specified COVID-19 orphanhood, age, date and registration requirements.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
benefits: Scholarship assistance for eligible girl students pursuing approved technical diploma or degree programmes.
eligibilitySummary: Girl students enrolled in eligible technical programmes, subject to the applicable intake, family income and other guidelines.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme
benefits: Financial assistance for eligible specially abled students pursuing approved technical diploma or degree programmes.
eligibilitySummary: Students meeting the applicable disability, course, institution, income and intake conditions.

name: PM YASASVI Top Class Education Scheme for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
benefits: Education assistance for eligible students under the applicable school or college scheme component.
eligibilitySummary: Students belonging to eligible OBC, EBC or DNT groups who meet the relevant education, income and institution requirements.

name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
benefits: Education assistance for eligible SC students studying in institutions covered by the scheme.
eligibilitySummary: SC students meeting the applicable institution, family income, admission and scholarship conditions.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
benefits: Pension assistance for eligible older persons under the National Social Assistance Programme, with state-specific additions potentially available.
eligibilitySummary: Older persons meeting the applicable age, poverty-status, identification and state implementation requirements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana
benefits: Support for eligible community development and socio-economic improvement activities under the scheme's applicable components.
eligibilitySummary: Eligibility depends on the particular scheme component, beneficiary group and implementing agency's criteria.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
benefits: Central financial assistance for eligible residential rooftop solar installations under scheme guidelines.
eligibilitySummary: Indian residential households with a suitable roof and valid electricity connection, subject to scheme conditions and previous subsidy restrictions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
benefits: A contributory pension scheme providing an assured pension of ₹3,000 per month to eligible subscribers after reaching the prescribed pension age.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40, with cultivable land up to 2 hectares and subject to exclusion criteria.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
benefits: A contributory pension scheme offering eligible unorganised workers an assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60, subject to scheme terms.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 with monthly income within the prescribed limit and meeting other conditions.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act Scheme
benefits: Provides a legal guarantee of up to 100 days of wage employment per financial year to eligible rural households, subject to the Act and applicable rules.
eligibilitySummary: Rural households whose adult members are willing to undertake unskilled manual work and meet registration and job-card requirements.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme
benefits: One-time financial assistance to an eligible household following the death of its primary breadwinner, subject to scheme rules.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible households meeting the applicable poverty, age, breadwinner and state implementation requirements.

name: PM POSHAN Scheme
benefits: Nutritional support through school meals for eligible children in covered schools.
eligibilitySummary: Children enrolled in eligible government and government-aided schools covered by the scheme, subject to applicable guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
benefits: Skill training and certification opportunities through approved programmes and training providers.
eligibilitySummary: Eligibility depends on the specific training course, candidate profile, and current programme guidelines.

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefits: Eligible artisans can receive recognition, skill training, toolkit incentives, credit support and marketing assistance.
eligibilitySummary: Adults engaged in one of the 18 notified traditional trades, subject to self-employment, family, previous-loan and other scheme conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
benefits: Collateral-free institutional credit for eligible micro-enterprise activities. Loan categories include Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus, subject to applicable terms.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible micro-enterprises and entrepreneurs assessed by participating lending institutions.

name: PM-SURAJ National Portal for Credit Support
benefits: Credit-support access for eligible disadvantaged entrepreneurs through participating institutions and applicable programmes.
eligibilitySummary: Eligibility depends on the credit product, applicant category, business proposal and participating institution's conditions.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
benefits: Apprenticeship opportunities and applicable government support under the current programme guidelines.
eligibilitySummary: Candidates and establishments must meet the applicable apprenticeship, trade, age and contract requirements.

name: e-Shram Portal
benefits: Registration of eligible unorganised workers in the national database to facilitate access to relevant social-security schemes.
eligibilitySummary: Unorganised workers who meet current registration conditions. Registration itself does not automatically confer every linked scheme benefit.
